verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents Workflows that automate machine learning tasks as GPU-backed pipelines, plus an API and CLI for programmatic resource control and an auto-shutdown policy. This supports scripted, unattended background jobs, but the evidence is a single marketing-level line on Workflows. Nothing shows scheduling, triggers, or how autonomous runs are monitored. missing for 10: scheduled/cron or event-triggered automation, documented background job execution and monitoring details, independent or hands-on corroboration that Workflows run autonomously.
